sourceLock.resolution: cargo 1.99.0-nightly generate-lockfile --offline from the staged, unchanged manifest; complete exact Cargo.lock v4 text, including all registry checksums, shipped at path above. The source-tree Cargo.lock is ignored and was not added.

targetGraph.explanation: cargo tree --locked --offline --target x86_64-pc-windows-gnu --edges normal,build; lockfile also records conditional/inactive packages

rebuild: From repository root, stage config/oem/reverse-open/shim/{Cargo.toml,build.rs,src/} byte-for-byte under .rtrt/tmp/release-0.12.0/shim-rebuild/source; restore licenses/provenance/Cargo.lock.txt there as Cargo.lock (byte-for-byte).

Verify staged source hashes and lock SHA-256 above. Use installed nightly with rustc -vV as above and the x86_64-pc-windows-gnu target plus the listed mingw linker/windres; no online dependency resolution.

Set STAGE to the absolute staged-source path; set SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=1791379871, CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true, CARGO_TARGET_X86_64_PC_WINDOWS_GNU_LINKER=x86_64-w64-mingw32-gcc, RUSTFLAGS=--remap-path-prefix=$STAGE=/src/winpodx-reverse-open-shim --remap-path-prefix=$HOME/.cargo=/cargo --remap-path-prefix=$HOME/.rustup=/rustup -C link-arg=-Wl,--no-insert-timestamp (expand variables in the shell).

Set CARGO_TARGET_DIR to a clean build directory under .rtrt/tmp/release-0.12.0/shim-rebuild; cargo +nightly build --release --locked --offline --target x86_64-pc-windows-gnu --manifest-path $STAGE/Cargo.toml; repeat with a second independent clean target directory and compare exe SHA-256.
reproducibility: Two independent clean target directories produced identical executable SHA-256; no Windows guest execution was performed.
